row.name: add_on_versions_module_check
row.value: module is null or module = any (array['coursework', 'peer_review', 'gradebook', 'attendance', 'timetable', 'news', 'website', 'custom_domains', 'admissions', 'student_records', 'badges', 'standards', 'exams', 'elearning', 'early_years', 'coding', 'video', 'integrations', 'sso', 'sms']::text[])

row.name: add_on_versions_limit_key_check
row.value: limit_key is null or limit_key = any (array['poolBytes', 'classBytes', 'moduleBytes', 'personBytes', 'students', 'staffAccounts', 'videoHours', 'customDomains', 'emailPerMonth', 'captionMinutes']::text[])

row.name: add_on_versions_shape_check
row.value:
(module is not null and limit_key is null and amount is null)
        or (module is null and limit_key is not null and amount is not null)
        or (module is null and limit_key is null and amount is null)

row.name: contacts_reach_check
row.value: email is not null or phone is not null

row.name: customers_terms_check
row.value: (terms_version is null) = (terms_accepted_at is null) and (dpa_version is null) = (dpa_accepted_at is null)

row.name: plan_versions_limits_check
row.value:
pool_bytes > 0 and class_bytes > 0 and module_bytes > 0 and person_bytes > 0
        and coalesce(students, 0) >= 0 and coalesce(staff_accounts, 0) >= 0
        and coalesce(video_hours, 0) >= 0 and coalesce(custom_domains, 0) >= 0
        and coalesce(email_per_month, 0) >= 0 and coalesce(caption_minutes, 0) >= 0

row.name: subscription_items_span_check
row.value: ends_on is null or ends_on > starts_on

row.name: subscription_overrides_module_check
row.value: module is null or module = any (array['coursework', 'peer_review', 'gradebook', 'attendance', 'timetable', 'news', 'website', 'custom_domains', 'admissions', 'student_records', 'badges', 'standards', 'exams', 'elearning', 'early_years', 'coding', 'video', 'integrations', 'sso', 'sms']::text[])

row.name: subscription_overrides_limit_key_check
row.value: limit_key is null or limit_key = any (array['poolBytes', 'classBytes', 'moduleBytes', 'personBytes', 'students', 'staffAccounts', 'videoHours', 'customDomains', 'emailPerMonth', 'captionMinutes']::text[])

row.name: subscription_overrides_shape_check
row.value:
(module is not null and granted is not null and limit_key is null and value is null)
        or (module is null and granted is null and limit_key is not null)

row.name: subscription_overrides_span_check
row.value: ends_on is null or ends_on > starts_on

row.name: subscriptions_term_check
row.value: (term_starts_on is null) = (term_ends_on is null) and (term_ends_on is null or term_ends_on > term_starts_on)

row.name: subscriptions_trial_check
row.value: state <> 'trial' or trial_ends_on is not null
